notes.title: Voronica Goes to Town coming out August 13!
notes.notes: [p]After two years of development, the sequel to Voronica Cleans House is coming to Steam! Much like the titular bunny, this baby is big! There are over six hours of gameplay and more than a hundred 'meals'. Also included are four different datable characters with seven distinct endings. Featured content includes same-size, macro/micro, oral, breast, cock and unbirth vore![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40578933/5566b93412063df79b012212855073baafdd19a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you liked Voronica Cleans House you are going to [b]love[/b] Voronica Goes to Town. It has more animations alone than the first game had CGs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40578933/dcae54180a01973517a23ca87e7077528d63d3d0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2480830/Voronica_Goes_to_Town_a_Vore_Adventure/"]Wishlist it today [/url]to get it on Wednesday! [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Sequel!
notes.notes:
Hello all,
After far too long a wait the store page for the sequel to Voronica Cleans House is now live!

This new game, '[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2480830/Voronica_Goes_to_Town_a_Vore_Adventure]Voronica Goes to Town[/url]' shows Voronica's continuing adventures in excess. This time with extensive animations! I think they're pretty great, but you can check it out for yourself in the game's trailer.

Thanks for following,
Heedless
